description: Play a web game (URL or ZIP build) as on a PC and as on a weak phone: errors, missing files, black or frozen screen, load time, draw calls, textures, shader stalls, memory leaks, build weight, video and screenshots. Price: $0.25 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Playtest: Plays a web game in a real browser, as on a PC and as on a weak phone, and reports what an agent needs to fix: errors, missing files, a black or frozen screen, load time, draw calls, texture memory, shader stalls, memory leaks and build weight, with a video and screenshots of each pass.

monkey.description: After the steps, press random keys, clicks and taps until the pass ends.

profiles.description: desktop: 1280x720; phone: 390x844 touch screen with the CPU slowed 4x.

seconds.description: Play time per profile, not counting loading.

seed.description: Random input seed, to repeat a run.

steps.description: Optional scenario played first: wait, key, click, tap, type.

key.description: A key name like ArrowRight, Space, Enter, w.

anyOf.description: x, y: fractions of the viewport (0.5, 0.5 is the middle).

url.description: Public URL of the game page.

zip.description: ZIP of a static web build as base64, up to about 35 MB (index.html at the root or one folder down; Unity WebGL builds work). Bigger builds: zipUrl, up to 50 MB.

name: playtest_run
